releaseNotes: Restore surfaces/workspace-template/repo-agent-entrypoints/.claude/settings.json, which the machine-global excludes file dropped when this repository was published as fresh history. Without it install-entrypoints exits 1 and every workspace initialization refuses with business.initialization_bootstrap_refused, so a first clone of the public repository could not create a workspace at all.

Un-ignore that template directory and its contents in .gitignore. Git cannot re-include a file inside an excluded directory, so the directory rule has to precede the contents rule; without both, a later git add silently drops the file again.

The failure named a bootstrap refusal rather than a missing file, and test:public-api runs five suites of which only the first passed, so a truncated log read as green. Restoring the file returns test:public-api to passing.
